context: Two students discuss the courtroom news from yesterday over coffee
purpose: Teach: 刑事/殺し/侵害/違法/正当/権限/戦闘/馬鹿

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 昨日のニュース見た？例の刑事事件、判決出たらしいよ。
lines.en: Did you see yesterday's news? Seems the verdict came out on that criminal case.
lines.style: casual university student leaning in over a coffee cup with mild excitement

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 見た見た！殺しの容疑だったのに、結局は正当防衛って認められたんでしょ？
lines.en: Yeah, I saw! It was a murder charge, but in the end self-defense was recognized, right?
lines.style: teen girl gasping then rattling off facts with breathless curiosity

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そうそう。でも検察側は、被告人の人権侵害があったって主張してて、ちょっと複雑なんだよね。
lines.en: Right, right. But the prosecution claimed there was a human rights violation against the defendant, so it's kind of messy.
lines.style: thoughtful undergrad explaining nuance with a furrowed brow

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: えー、警察の取り調べが違法だったってこと？それマジで馬鹿げてるじゃん。
lines.en: Huh, you mean the police interrogation was illegal? That's seriously ridiculous.
lines.style: teen voice spiking with indignant disbelief between sips

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 弁護士が言うには、警察にそこまで踏み込む権限はなかったらしいよ。
lines.en: According to the lawyer, the police didn't have the authority to push that far.
lines.style: measured tone of a student reciting what he read this morning

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: なんか刑事ドラマみたい。法廷で弁護士と検事が戦闘モードでやり合ってたって。
lines.en: It's like a crime drama. They said in the courtroom the lawyer and prosecutor went at each other in full battle mode.
lines.style: teen girl giggling and dramatizing the scene with wide eyes

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 笑い事じゃないって。一人の人生かかってたんだから。
lines.en: It's no laughing matter. A person's whole life was on the line.
lines.style: gentle reproach from an older friend trying to recenter the conversation

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ごめんごめん。でも無罪になって良かったよね、ほんとに。
lines.en: Sorry, sorry. But it's genuinely good he was found innocent, right?
lines.style: teen softening her tone, apologetic but still warm and a bit sheepish
